title: Replace non-realistic game visuals with more realistic images (Ludo, Chess, Carrom)

requirements.text: Replace the current non-realistic visuals with more realistic images for Ludo, Chess, and Carrom, keeping the existing asset filenames/paths so the UI updates without changing navigation or gameplay.

quotes: Game not realistic picture such as ludo chess carrom

acceptanceCriteria: The images at /assets/generated/ludo-icon.dim_512x512.png, /assets/generated/chess-icon.dim_512x512.png, and /assets/generated/carrom-icon.dim_512x512.png are updated to look more realistic (photorealistic or realistic 3D render style).
HomeScreen game cards render the updated images (no broken links; images remain 512x512 and look crisp when shown in the square thumbnail).
No changes to game rules, game logic, or navigation flow (onSelectGame continues to work as-is).

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or anything under frontend/src/components/ui.
Do not introduce any new backend canisters or external services; use static assets served from frontend/public/assets/generated.
nonGoals: Do not change gameplay mechanics for Ludo, Chess, or Carrom.
Do not add multiplayer/online play or any real-time features.

edits: Make the Ludo image more realistic (ludo-icon.dim_512x512.png > ludo-icon.dim_512x512.png)
Make the Chess image more realistic (chess-icon.dim_512x512.png > chess-icon.dim_512x512.png)
Make the Carrom image more realistic (carrom-icon.dim_512x512.png > carrom-icon.dim_512x512.png)
